title: Punishment for murder
summary: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
source_ref: Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. 45 of 1860), India Code (indiacode.nic.in)

title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
summary: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and fine.
source_ref: Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. 45 of 1860), India Code (indiacode.nic.in)

title: Attempt to murder
summary: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge, and under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of murder, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
punishment: 10 years + fine, or life imprisonment if hurt is caused
source_ref: Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. 45 of 1860), India Code (indiacode.nic.in)

title: Punishment for rape
summary: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
punishment: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 10 years, up to life + fine
source_ref: Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. 45 of 1860), India Code (indiacode.nic.in)

title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
summary: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to make, alter or destroy the whole or any part of a valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
source_ref: Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. 45 of 1860), India Code (indiacode.nic.in)

title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
summary: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
source_ref: Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. 45 of 1860), India Code (indiacode.nic.in)

title: Information in cognizable cases
summary: Every information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence, if given orally to an officer in charge of a police station, shall be reduced to writing by him or under his direction, and be read over to the informant.
source_ref: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Act No. 2 of 1974), India Code

title: Direction for grant of bail to person apprehending arrest
summary: Where any person has reason to believe that he may be arrested on an accusation of having committed a non-bailable offence, he may apply to the High Court or the Court of Session for a direction under this section.
source_ref: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Act No. 2 of 1974), India Code

title: Admissibility of electronic records
summary: Any information contained in an electronic record which is printed on a paper, stored, recorded or copied in optical or magnetic media produced by a computer shall be deemed to be also a document.
source_ref: Indian Evidence Act, 1872 (Act No. 1 of 1872), India Code
